blockers.noTarget: The target bin is missing on {n} line(s).

detail.suggestedApplied: A bin was assigned to {n} line(s); {m} without a suggestion.
detail.confirmBodyDirect: Receipt {number} is confirmed in full: each line goes to its target bin, with no put-away tasks. It can no longer be changed.

header.readOnlyNote: The receipt is already confirmed: its header cannot be changed.
header.documentNote: With an advance ship notice or a purchase order, the origin, the warehouse and the expected quantities come from the document.
header.warehouseFixedNote: The warehouse can only be changed on a receipt without a document and without lines.
header.deleteBody: Delete receipt {number}? If it came from a client notice, the notice becomes pending again; if it came from a purchase order, the order can be received again.
header.modeHelp: Defaults to the warehouse's; it can only change while the receipt is open.

capture.title: Lot and serials · {product}
capture.serialQty: For a serial-tracked product, the received quantity is the number of serials captured: {count}.

putawayTab.select: Select a receipt to see its put-away tasks
putawayTab.noTasks: This receipt has no put-away tasks.
putawayTab.directInfo: {code} receives direct to bin: only receipts from before the change or with cross-docking appear here.

damage.title: Damaged units of {product}
damage.intro: Of the {received} received, how many arrived damaged? The report is created when the receipt is confirmed and they leave the good stock.
damage.placeHelp: They are left in the bin you choose; if none, the first quarantine bin (or where the line lands if there is none).
damage.discardHelp: They leave the inventory when the receipt is confirmed, with a Damage adjustment.

errors.qtyPositive: The damaged quantity must be greater than 0.
errors.qtyMax: The damaged quantity cannot exceed the received one ({max}).
errors.noteRequired: Write the reason for the damage when the cause is Other.
errors.finalDestinationRequired: Say where the goods that leave go (thrown away, returned to supplier, donated…).

asns.title: Advance shipping notices
asns.cancelBody: Cancel advance shipping notice #{id}? It can no longer be received.

errors.clientRequired: Enter the client that owns the goods of the notice.
errors.referenceMax: The reference allows at most 80 characters.
errors.expectedQtyPositive: The expected quantity must be greater than zero.
errors.tooManyLines: An advance shipping notice allows at most 200 lines.

pickBatches.title: Pick & pack
pickBatches.subtitle: Pick inventory by FEFO or by bin, lot or serial, and pack it as a transport order.
pickBatches.searchPlaceholder: Number, pack, order, invoice, client or SKU
pickBatches.linesHelp: A pick batch holds products of a single owner. Without bin or lot the system picks by FEFO.

detail.deleteBody: Delete pick batch {number}? Inventory goes back to its original bin.
detail.deletePackedBody: Delete pick batch {number}? Its order {order} is deleted too and inventory goes back to its original bin.

pack.title: Pack {number}
pack.ownerHelp: Must be the client that owns the inventory: {client}.
pack.noLocations: Your user cannot view the directory: enter a new one.
pack.name: Name
pack.countryHelp: 2-letter ISO code. Empty: the default country.

errors.consigneeRequired: The consignee is required: choose one from the directory or enter a new one.
errors.packagesRequired: Enter at least one package line.
errors.pieces: The number of pieces must be at least 1.

pickBatches.splitLabel: Resize the Picking and Pick batches panels

collectPanel.title: Picking
collectPanel.maxLines: Up to 100 lines per pick batch.
collectPanel.planNeedsQty: Pick the product and enter the quantity to suggest where to take it from.
collectPanel.planShort: Not enough stock: {short} short. Lower the quantity.
collectPanel.planApplied: Suggested: {count} bin(s). You can change each one with its picker.

cycleCounts.title: Cycle count
cycleCounts.subtitle: Variance and adjustment against the ledger: count bin by bin and confirm in one step.
cycleCounts.intro: Informed count: the counter sees the expected quantity. Variance is computed on the fly and, on confirm, the difference is written as an adjustment to the Movement ledger; nothing is adjusted outside it.
cycleCounts.splitLabel: Resize the count list and the selected count
cycleCounts.createHelp: Without zones or bins the whole on-hand balance of the warehouse is taken (up to 1000 lines).
cycleCounts.createProductHelp: With a product it is counted in every position and lot where the system says there is stock (one line per position and lot). Without a product an empty count opens and you add the products you scan, each with its quantity and position.
cycleCounts.deleteBody: Delete pending count {number}? Its count task is cancelled and the deletion is audited.

fields.onlyWithStockHelp: With the switch on, the list shows only products that have stock in the chosen warehouse; off, all active products (if the product has no stock the server says so when creating).
fields.binsTruncated: Only the first {count} bins are listed: choose zones to narrow the list.
fields.productOptionalHelp: Optional: leave it empty to open a count where you will add several scanned products.

errors.lotAmbiguous: Give the lot by its id or by its number, not both.

detail.title: Count
detail.staleHelp: The balance changed since the snapshot was taken.
detail.staleNote: Some lines changed since the snapshot. 'Refresh snapshot' takes them again and clears their capture.
detail.changedHelp: When confirmed the balance differed from the snapshot; the adjustment used the real balance.
detail.blindNote: Your user lacks the informed-count permission: expected quantities are hidden and counting is done in the warehouse app.
detail.addLineHelp: A product that is in a position but not in the count: it is added with what was counted. The position is optional if the product is in only one.
detail.confirmNote: On confirm, each line with variance generates an adjustment linked to this count ({number}).
detail.unsaved: Some quantities could not be saved; fix them before confirming.
detail.closedNote: Count closed. Adjustments are already in the Movement ledger.
detail.seeAdjustments: See the adjustments in the ledger

blockers.closed: The count was already confirmed; it is read-only.
blockers.blind: The web does not confirm blind counts.

detail.failingCount: {shown} of {total} lines: only the failing ones
detail.failingNone: No line fails: everything matches the current stock.
detail.reviewNote: Review: changing a quantity is recorded as a correction (not an adjustment): what the operator counted is kept, with who corrected it and when.
detail.binOptionalHelp: Optional: without a position the only one where the system has the product is used.

scan.label: Scan or search product
scan.help: Scan or type the code and press Enter: it goes to the line and asks for the quantity.
scan.notFound: That code is not in this count. Use "Add what was found" if the product is in the bin.
scan.many: {n} lines match: choose the bin and lot.

qty.title: Count {product}
qty.countedHelp: Enter saves. Empty clears the capture (the line goes back to pending).

changes.title: Count what changed
changes.intro: Creates a Pending count for each bin with movements in the window (except adjustments coming from a count), with everything in it. Up to 200 bins at a time.
changes.timeHelp: Company time ({zone}). By default, from the last time it was generated in this warehouse (the first time, from the start of the day) until now.
changes.includeEmptyHelp: Bins that were left at 0 are counted too, to confirm they are really empty.
changes.firstTime: First time in this warehouse: from the start of the day.
changes.positions: {n} count(s) will be created, one per bin, with {lines} line(s)
changes.withOpen: {n} bin(s) already have a pending count (skipped)
changes.max: Up to {max} bins at a time.
changes.created: {n} count(s) of what changed were created.

review.title: To review
review.splitLabel: Resize the review list and the selected count
review.intro: Counts the operator already finished. "Matches" is measured against the current stock, not the snapshot: if a position moved since the snapshot, the count stays for review.
review.selectOnlyMatching: Only counts that match can be selected.
review.selectHelp: {n} count(s) on this page match. With none selected, "Close the ones that match" closes all of them on this page; with boxes checked, only the selected ones.
review.closeNone: No count on this page matches.
review.closeBody: {n} matching count(s) will be closed: {list}. They end as Match and do not move inventory. Before closing each one the current stock is checked again; if it changed, it stays for review.
review.closePageNote: Only the matching counts of the page shown (with the filters above).
review.commentHelp: Stays in the history of each closed count. Up to 500 characters.
review.commentTooLong: The comment allows at most 500 characters.
review.truncated: At most 200 counts were reviewed in this call; repeat for the rest.

skip.Stale: The stock changed while closing; review it.

review.empty: No counts to review with these filters.

provisional.help: Position created from a count by the counter. The supervisor confirms, corrects or deactivates it.

preview.intro: Preview of the effect against the current stock of each position. Nothing is written until you confirm, and it is all or nothing.
preview.changedHelp: The snapshot said {qty}; the adjustment is calculated against the current stock.
preview.pendingNote: {n} line(s) still to count: it cannot be confirmed until they are counted.
preview.matchNote: Match: the count agrees with the current stock; confirming adjusts nothing.
preview.varianceNote: Confirming will post {n} movement(s) to the ledger and the count will end as Variance.
preview.changedNote: The stock of {n} position(s) changed since the snapshot; the adjustment is calculated against the current stock.

blockers.errors: {n} line(s) have errors; fix them before confirming.

calc.title: Quantity calculator
calc.depthHelp: Depth: how many are one behind another (blank = 1).
calc.hint: Enter rows, columns and, if any, depth; or just the loose ones.
calc.incompleteBlock: Each block needs rows and columns.
calc.invalid: Enter whole numbers in rows, columns and depth (depth 1 or more) and a number in loose.

discrepancies.title: Ledger ↔ balance discrepancies
discrepancies.subtitle: The ledger rules: a discrepancy is fixed by setting the balance to what the ledger says, or dismissed with a note.
discrepancies.runHint: Checks balances against the ledger now (the filtered products, or all).
discrepancies.runResult: Reconciliation of {date}: {products} products and {balances} balances checked · {opened} new discrepancies · {stillOpen} still open · {selfCorrected} corrected themselves.
discrepancies.emptyBody: The ledger and the balances match with these filters.
discrepancies.rebuild: Fix the balance from the ledger
discrepancies.selfCorrected: The balance already matched; the discrepancy closed itself.
discrepancies.createCount: Create a count for that bin

errors.dismissNotes: Write a note explaining why the discrepancy is dismissed.
errors.notesMax: The note allows at most 500 characters.

detail.title: Discrepancy · {sku}
detail.ledgerRules: A discrepancy is not a physical difference on the shelf (a count solves that): the balance does not match the sum of the movements. Fixing sets the balance to the ledger without creating a movement; an adjustment or a count does not fix it because they move both by the same amount.
detail.notesPlaceholder: Why it is fixed or dismissed
detail.totalHelp: This discrepancy is for the product total: fix the per-bin discrepancies, or dismiss it with a note.
detail.countOffer: The balance now matches the ledger. To verify what is physically in the bin, create a count.

convertSerial.title: Convert {sku} to serial
convertSerial.intro: {sku} is not tracked and has {units} unit(s) on hand. Enter one serial number per unit, in the bin where it is.
convertSerial.pasteHelp: One serial per line (you can paste several lines; commas also separate). No repeats, not even across bins.
convertSerial.notesHelp: If left empty, the movements say “Serial conversion”.
convertSerial.noStock: The product has no stock in bins.
convertSerial.confirmBody: {serials} serials of {sku} will be created in {positions} bin(s).
convertSerial.netZero: It is a net-zero movement: for each bin an outbound adjustment of the untracked units and an inbound adjustment per serial are posted, with the reason “Serial conversion”. On hand and available do not change.
convertSerial.oneWay: Afterwards the product is serial-tracked (adjustments, transfers, picks and receipts ask for serials) and does not go back to “not tracked”.

errors.tooMany: A line allows at most 500 serial numbers.
errors.reserved: Product {sku} has reserved units; release them before converting it.
errors.notInBin: The stock of {sku} in {where} is not in a bin without lot; move or adjust it before converting it.
errors.fractional: The stock of {sku} in {bin} is {qty}; adjust it to whole units before converting it.

split.perBinHelp: To split {total} across several bins, enter how much goes in each. Empty = everything in one bin.
split.perBinHelpOn: Pick the bins one by one: this quantity is left in each.
split.repeated: That bin is already in the split.
split.noRoom: No units left to split: all {total} are split.
split.capacityWarn: Room for {free}: it will receive {qty}. You can confirm anyway.
split.receiptIntro: The {qty} received on this line are split. Whatever does not fit in full bins stays in a line without a bin, to pick one in the grid.
split.receiptFailed: {done} change(s) were made and one failed: {message} Check the receipt lines.

damage.title: Damage
damage.subtitle: what arrived damaged in a receipt or got damaged in the warehouse: quarantine, release or recover
damage.empty: No damage reports match these filters.
damage.originReceiptHelp: Those units do not enter as good stock: sent to quarantine they enter that position; released, they never enter inventory.
damage.originWarehouseHelp: The goods are already in inventory: they move from their position to quarantine, or come out of inventory if released.
damage.newLotHelp: If the lot does not exist yet, type its number.
damage.quarantineHelp: Goes to the warehouse quarantine position; later it is released or recovered.
damage.discardHelp: Leaves inventory now, with a Damage adjustment.
damage.discardBody: {qty} of {sku} in {bin} are taken out: they leave the inventory with a Damage adjustment. Say where they go.
damage.recoverBody: {qty} of {sku} leave {bin} and return to a storage position.
damage.toBinHelp: A storage position (not quarantine, receiving, cross-dock or rental).

errors.quantityPositive: The damaged quantity must be greater than 0.
errors.dispositionRequired: Say whether it goes to quarantine or is released.
errors.fromBinRequired: Say the position where the damaged goods are.
errors.receiptRequired: Say the receipt it arrived damaged in.
errors.toBinRequired: Say the position the recovered goods return to.
errors.finalDestinationRequired: Say where the goods that leave go (thrown away, returned to supplier, donated…).

damage.quarantineBinHelp: Empty: the first quarantine bin of the warehouse. It can be any active bin.
damage.finalDestinationHelp: Where what leaves quarantine goes. It is recorded in the ledger and in the damage reports.

productLabels.hint: PDF with one label per product (SKU barcode, large SKU and name) for 4 × 2, 4 × 4 or 4 × 6 inch label printers. Prints what the table shows.
productLabels.title: Product labels
productLabels.intro: One label per product in the filtered list, with its SKU barcode, the SKU in large type and its name. Each label is one PDF page of the exact label size (label only, no sheet). You can reprint them any time: they change nothing in the system.
productLabels.working: Reading products and generating the PDF…
productLabels.tooMany: There are {count} products; the maximum per PDF is {max} labels. Narrow it with the filters.
productLabels.nothing: There are no products to print with the current filters.

devices.title: Mobile devices
devices.subtitle: Devices with access to Teikem Almacén. The enrollment code is single-use and lasts 24 hours.
devices.deactivateBody: Deactivate {name}? All its sessions are revoked and it stops syncing.
devices.reactivateBody: Reactivate {name}? Each user signs in again with their PIN.
devices.newEnrollCodeBody: Generate a new enrollment code for {name}? The previous one stops working.
devices.enrollCodeHint: Enter it on the Register screen of Teikem Almacén. It is only shown once.
devices.copyFailed: Could not copy it; select it by hand.

users.title: Roles and users
users.subtitle: Who can sign in to Teikem and what they can do.

roles.title: Roles
roles.name: Name
roles.deleteBody: The role {name} will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
roles.note: A role is a reusable set of permissions — changing it affects every user who has it assigned. {count} roles come pre-built ({names}); they can be freely edited, renamed, or you can create new ones — the only guard is you can't delete one that still has users on it.
roles.noteGeneric: A role is a reusable set of permissions — changing it affects every user who has it assigned. Roles can be freely edited, renamed, or you can create new ones — the only guard is you can't delete one that still has users on it.

users.title: Users
users.requireMfaBody: {name} will have to set up two-step verification before they can sign in.
users.unrequireMfaBody: {name} will no longer be required to have two-step verification (they may keep it if already active).
users.resetMfaBody: Removes {name}'s two-step verification; if still required, it will ask them to set it up again on their next sign-in.
users.passwordHelp: Empty: a temporary password is generated and shown once, so you can send it to the person.
users.alsoCompaniesHelp: Signs in with the same user and password, with the same roles (by name) in each company you tick. Only companies where you manage users are listed.
users.tempPasswordHint: Copy it and send it to the person — it can't be shown again. They can change it later from their account.
users.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it; select it by hand.
users.portalHint: Portal users are managed from the client's record (Batch 2).
users.extraHint: Permissions from their current role are already included and can't be removed here — edit the role for that. What you turn on below are extra permissions, just for this person.
users.closeSessionsBody: All of {name}'s open sessions will be signed out.
users.note: Each user inherits their role's permissions. "Extra permissions" is the one-off exception: a permission granted directly to a person, without creating or changing a role just for them.

pin.removeBody: {name} will no longer be able to sign in to Teikem Almacén with a PIN.

tempPw.title: Temporary password
tempPw.rule1: It lasts 10 minutes. If nobody signs in with it by then, the previous password comes back.
tempPw.rule2: When they sign in with it, the system makes them choose their own password.
tempPw.customHelp: Leave blank to have the system generate one. At least 12 characters.
tempPw.resultHint: Give this password to {name} now: it lasts {minutes} minutes and is not shown again.

catalogs.title: Value catalogs
catalogs.subtitle: The lists that feed chips and selects across the app.
catalogs.deleteListBody: Delete the list «{name}»? This action can't be undone.
catalogs.name: Name (es)
catalogs.adjustHelp: A system value is never disabled globally; use this adjustment (Enabled = No) instead of deleting it.
catalogs.restoreOverrideBody: Restore «{label}» to the system value? Your company's adjustment is lost.
catalogs.deactivateBody: Deactivate «{label}»? It stops being offered when capturing; history still shows it.
catalogs.restoreValueBody: Restore «{label}»? It's offered again when capturing.
catalogs.empty: This list doesn't have any values yet.

settings.readOnly: Read-only: your user does not have permission to change the company settings (admin.tenant).
settings.loadError: The company settings could not be read.
settings.note: Each company keeps its own settings. When saved, the region and formats apply across the whole app without reloading; each user's language does not change.

general.nameHint: The name is changed by the Teikem team.
general.langHint: The language each new user starts with; anyone can change it in their account. It does not change dates or currency: that is set in Region & formats.
general.secLinkHint: The MFA policy, reauthentication and session lifetime are set in Security & audit, so the same controls are not in two screens.

region.regionHint: The region loads the time zone, currency and every format at once. You can then change each one on its own.
region.regionApplied: Region applied: check the preview and save.
region.tzHint: Defines what day “today” is, where each day starts and ends in filters, business days and SLA, and the time shown on screen. Dates are stored in UTC and shown in this zone.
region.curHint: Default currency for rates, invoices and COD. A client can have a different one in its contract.
region.sepSwapped: The thousands and decimal separators cannot be the same: the other one was changed.
region.phoneHint: Phones are stored as digits only and shown in this format. If a number does not have the digits the format needs, it is left as typed.
region.previewHint: With the values of this form, even if not saved.
region.symRequired: The currency symbol is required and 1 to 3 characters long, for example $.

calendar.workdaysHint: Together with holidays this defines the working calendar: business-day SLAs, deadlines and “last N business days” trends skip non-working days.
calendar.needOneWorkDay: At least one working day is required
calendar.needHolidayName: Enter the holiday date and name
calendar.removeMessage: {name} ({date}) is removed from the working calendar.

modules.modulesHint: A module that is off hides its screens from the sidebar and the search palette, and the server rejects its operations. Turning one on requires its parent module; turning it off also turns off the ones that depend on it. Changing a module asks you to confirm your identity (reauthentication) if you have not done so recently.
modules.confirmOffMessage: Turning {name} off also turns off: {list}. Their screens disappear from the menu.
modules.loadError: The module catalog could not be read.

ops.defaultsHint: These pre-select the fields in Quick and Detailed entry — operators can change them per order, but they don't start blank.
ops.maxStopsHint: Used for any driver without their own max set in Drivers & rates — you can set a per-driver exception there.
ops.pipelineHint: Which actions each order status allows (StatusCapability). The server enforces them on every operation; without a company rule the platform rule applies (allowed if there is none).
ops.pipelineReadOnly: Read-only: changing the matrix requires the admin.statusconfig permission.
ops.pipelineNoAccess: Your user cannot read the status pipeline.
ops.recvSumHint: Read-only. The mode is changed in each warehouse (Warehouses → Receiving), because the receiving area is physical. With putaway: goods enter the receiving location and are put away afterwards. Direct: the receiver picks the final location and there is no putaway. A warehouse with putaway needs a receiving location in order to receive.
ops.recvNoAccess: Your user cannot read the warehouses.
ops.countRevealTitle: Cycle count: expected quantity while counting
ops.countRevealLabel: Who sees the expected quantity while counting?

countRevealHelp.NONE: Nobody sees the expected quantity while counting in the app, not even the supervisor. Reconciling on the web still shows it.
countRevealHelp.MARKED: Only counters marked «Yes» in Users see it, after capturing each line.
countRevealHelp.ALL: All counters see it after capturing each line, except those marked «No» in Users.

ops.countTolLabel: Margin before asking for a recount (%)
ops.countTolHelp: 0 = any difference asks for a recount. With 5, a quantity within 5 % of the expected one is accepted.
ops.countTolRange: The margin must be between 0 and 100 %.
ops.countNumberText: Show the number (otherwise just «Matches» or «Does not match»)
ops.countNumberHelp: Outside the margin the expected quantity is never shown: a recount is requested. The number is only seen on a match or after recounting.
ops.countRevealHint: With «Only marked users» or «Everybody», whoever has the «Count» permission (supervisor) sees the expected quantity from the start. The counter (only «Capture count») sees it after accepting each line; outside the margin a recount is requested and the line closes. With «Nobody» nobody sees it while counting in the app.

brand.brandHint: State colors (green, amber, red) are deliberately not customizable: green means good and red means bad is a convention that, once broken, makes the interface read backwards.
brand.flowHint: What goes out to the street: orders, routes, deliveries.
brand.moneyHint: The money coming back: COD, billing, settlement.
brand.neutralHint: Backgrounds, panels, lines and text across the whole app come from this. It is what makes a theme feel cool, warm or plain gray.
brand.hexInvalid: Enter a hexadecimal color, for example #1F6FE5.
brand.brandReset: Branding reset: save to apply it to the company.
brand.previewNote: Preview: the app already shows these colors; save to keep them for the company or discard to go back to the saved ones.
brand.serverNote: The server repeats these checks when saving: a brand that does not pass is rejected.
brand.logoHint: Full lockup and square mark, each with a variant for dark backgrounds. SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP up to 512 KB. If one variant is missing the other is used; with no logo at all the Teikem one is used.
brand.logoTooBig: The logo exceeds the 512 KB maximum size.
brand.logoNone: No logo: the Teikem one is used

slotHints.lockup: Full symbol and name: expanded sidebar.
slotHints.lockup-inverted: The same lockup, inverted for the dark theme.
slotHints.mark: Just the square symbol: collapsed sidebar.
slotHints.mark-inverted: The square mark, inverted for the dark theme.

activity.title: Activity
activity.exportTruncated: The first {n} rows were downloaded; narrow the date to export the rest.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.revokeBody: {user}'s session on {device} will be closed. They will have to sign in again on that device.
sessions.revokeOthersBody: {n} company sessions will be closed: all but this one. Each user will have to sign in again.
sessions.locationHint: IP the session was opened or last renewed from

policy.title: Tenant MFA policy
policy.mfaRequiredHint: When on, every user must enable two-factor authentication before they can sign in — not just whoever opts in.
policy.reauthHint: Sensitive actions (approving billing, changing permissions, exporting to accounting) require reauthentication if the last verification is older than this window.
policy.sessionDaysHint: How long a session lasts without asking for the password again; it renews while in use. Warehouse devices (device + PIN) have their own lifetime. 1 to 365 days.
policy.readOnly: Read only: changing the policy requires the permission to manage the tenant (admin.tenant).
policy.loadError: The tenant settings could not be loaded.

audit.note: "Activity" combines, in one table, two logs the system keeps separately: what changed (change log) and who attempted what (security events); each row keeps its type. Dates and times are in the tenant's time zone (Region & formats).

rentals.title: Rentals
rentals.subtitle: Own serial-tracked equipment rented to a client location: contract, pickup date and extensions
rentals.notFound: The rental does not exist or does not belong to your company.
rentals.emptyBody: Change or clear the filters, or create a rental with “New rental”.

filters.bothNote: With both filters you see the overdue ones and those due in the next {days} days.
filters.searchPlaceholder: Number, contract, client, location or serial

due.none: No due date: the rental is not open

form.clientLocked: The rental's client cannot be changed; cancel the rental and create another.
form.noLocations: The client has no active locations of its own.
form.locationsForbidden: Your user cannot read locations (locations.read permission and Catalog module).
form.contactsForbidden: Your user cannot read the client's contacts (clients.read permission).
form.warehouseLocked: Remove the rental's equipment before changing the source warehouse.
form.datesLocked: The rental already has extensions; the pickup date changes with an extension.
form.deliveryCostHelp: Data only: shipments will come with the Shipments module.
form.equipmentEmpty: No equipment yet. Add it now or later, on the rental's page.
form.equipmentCleared: The source warehouse changed: the chosen equipment was removed (it belonged to another warehouse).

picker.title: Add equipment by serial
picker.convertHint: Convert it with “Convert to serial” on the product page.
picker.serialSearchHint: Filters the list; Enter with the exact serial picks it (barcode scanner).
picker.none: No available serials of this equipment in {warehouse}.
picker.more: and {count} more: use the search box.
picker.hidden: {count} serial(s) in zones that are not rented (quarantine or cross-dock) are not shown.
picker.scheduledNote: The rental is Scheduled: the units you add are reserved right away.

rate.title: Rate of unit {serial}
rate.help: The rate is data only (nothing is calculated or billed). Before dispatch the current rate is corrected; afterwards it changes with an extension.

detail.noEquipmentBody: Add it with “Add equipment” before scheduling.
detail.cancelledLines: Cancelled rental: this is the equipment it had (inactive).
detail.noShipment: No shipment (coming with the Shipments module)

confirm.scheduleBody: The {units} unit(s) are reserved for this rental: the product's available quantity goes down and on hand does not change.
confirm.dispatchBody: Each unit moves with a transfer to the EN-RENTA bin of warehouse {warehouse}: it still belongs to the company (on hand), does not count as available and its serial becomes “On rent”. The rental becomes On rent.
confirm.cancelBodyDraft: The rental becomes Cancelled (read only) and its units inactive. Nothing was reserved.
confirm.cancelBodyScheduled: The rental becomes Cancelled (read only): the reservations are released and the serials are available again.
confirm.removeBody: The unit becomes inactive in the rental (kept in the audit log) and the serial is free for another rental.
confirm.removeBodyScheduled: The unit becomes inactive in the rental (kept in the audit log) and its reservation is released: the serial is available again.

extend.title: Extend rental {number}
extend.newPickupHelp: Must be later than the current one.
extend.rateHelp: Only if it changes: the current rate closes and a new one starts the day after the previous pickup. A rate equal to the current one changes nothing.

errors.locationRequired: Enter the client location where the equipment will be.
errors.pickupBeforeStart: The pickup date cannot be earlier than the start date.
errors.contractTooLong: The contract number allows at most 80 characters.
errors.negativeDeliveryCost: The estimated transport cost cannot be negative.
errors.newPickupNotLater: The new pickup date must be later than the current one ({date}).
errors.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the extension.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason allows at most 300 characters.
errors.frequencyRequired: Enter the billing frequency: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY or ONE_TIME.
errors.notSerial: Product {sku} is not serial-tracked; only equipment with a serial number is rented.
errors.notOwn: Only own equipment is rented; {sku} belongs to a client.
errors.serialAlreadyPicked: Serial {serial} is already in this rental.
errors.tooManyLines: A rental allows at most 200 units.
errors.commentTooLong: The comment allows at most 500 characters.
errors.noRateLines: Choose at least one unit for the new rate.

summary.label: Rentals summary
summary.onRentHint: rentals with the equipment at the client
summary.dueSoonHint: picked up from today to {days} days

rentalReturns.title: Rental returns
rentalReturns.subtitle: equipment coming back from a rental: reason, condition, destination and processing
rentalReturns.emptyBody: A return is registered from the detail of an On rent rental (Register return).

filters.searchPlaceholder: DRN number, rental number or serial

form.title: Register return of rental {number}
form.intro: Equipment coming back from {client}. Current pickup date: {pickup}.
form.returnedOnHelp: Today by default; it cannot be in the future nor before the rental start.
form.earlyNote: Early return: the date is before the pickup date ({pickup}).
form.notesOtherHelp: With the reason “Other”, describe the return.
form.pickupCostHelp: Data only: the pickup will come from a shipment once that module exists.
form.destinationHelp: Empty = each unit goes back to the location it left from. It can be another warehouse (e.g. a workshop quarantine); never the On rent zone.
form.effects: Each unit comes back with a transfer from EN-RENTA to its destination. With processing it stays on hand but reserved (“In processing”) until finished; without processing it is available right away. You can return only part: the rental stays On rent until the last unit comes back.
form.noPending: There are no units left to return in this rental.
form.processNo: No: it is available right away.

toast.createdClosed: Return {number} registered: {count} unit(s). Rental {rental} is now Returned.

errors.reasonRequired: Enter the return reason: END_OF_CONTRACT, EARLY_DAMAGE, EARLY_CLIENT or OTHER.
errors.otherNeedsNotes: With the reason 'Other', describe the return in the notes.
errors.lineNotesTooLong: Unit notes allow at most 500 characters.
errors.returnedOnFuture: The return date cannot be in the future.
errors.returnedOnBeforeStart: The return date cannot be before the rental start ({date}).
errors.negativePickupCost: The estimated pickup cost cannot be negative.
errors.noLines: Enter at least one serial being returned.

rentalProcesses.title: Equipment processing
rentalProcesses.subtitle: returned equipment under review until ready (or scrapped)
rentalProcesses.emptyBody: A process opens when a unit is returned with “Goes through processing?”.
rentalProcesses.scrapNeedsAdjust: Scrapping also requires the inventory.adjust permission (inventory adjustments), which your user does not have: ask an administrator.

advance.title: Advance the processing of {serial}
advance.help: Choose the step it moves to. It goes to the next enabled step, to Repair or Awaiting parts from any step, and back from there; an out-of-order jump is rejected by the server with its message. To finish use “Complete” or “Scrap”.

complete.title: Complete the processing of {serial}
complete.body: The process becomes “Ready”: the reservation is released, the serial is Available and the product's available quantity comes back.
complete.binHelp: Only locations of the same warehouse and outside the On rent zone; to another warehouse, with a transfer afterwards.

scrap.title: Scrap {serial}
scrap.body: An outbound adjustment (−1) of {sku} from {bin} is recorded with the reason “Damage” and serial {serial} is scrapped: it leaves inventory and does not come back. This cannot be undone.

errors.statusRequired: Enter the status the process moves to.
errors.scrapConfirm: Type the serial {serial} to confirm the scrap.

rentalReports.title: Rental reports
rentalReports.subtitle: views, indicators and chart of rentals, returns and processing (Analytics)
rentalReports.pulseHint: To see them on your Pulse, turn on “Show on my Pulse” in Analytics → Indicators (they come off: “Needs your attention” already shows every overdue or due rental).
rentalReports.emptyView: The view has no rows today.
